paragraphs: He is mentioned in Midrash Tehillim 5:2.[^1]

notes.text: The stored OYW digital text of Midrash Tehillim 5:2 has only אמר ר' חנן (R' Chanan), without a patronymic and with an abbreviated title. Hyman's heading has Chanin bar Ada. This is a partial name nonmatch; it neither establishes the fuller identity nor supplies an expanded Rabbi title.
